title: Three Autumns and One Short Stick
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：grandfather　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grandfather 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the boy ① thanked a grandfather that no cousin in the yard would have described, and he said the thanking was the whole of the autumn. The ② grandfather, meaning the man himself and not the portrait, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a grandfather, he said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ grandfather in that yard had the same short stick beside him, and the ④ grandfather at the far gate, meaning the one they kept for the children to visit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A grandfather, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the boy said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grandfather was the whole of the matter, meaning the elder and not the man. The ⑥ grandfather, meaning the elder and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grandfather, he said, is either something you thank or the only word that means both a man and an elder. He said the elder is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ grandfather had become a line in a will, and the will had become an argument about the short stick. The ⑧ grandfather of the whole thing, the boy wrote in November, was one yard and three autumns of describing; grandfather, he said, is either the one at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grandfather I remember is the one described in the will, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ grandfather, my mother said in 1969, is the only one that improves by being described; every grandfather, she said, is an elder that has agreed to look like a man. She said the elder was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 祖父；外祖父（指院子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 祖父；外祖父（指那个人本人，与画像相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank a grandfather 向一位祖父道谢
D. n. 祖父（指留给孩子们去探望的那一位）
E. n. 祖父（抽象总称，指一处院子的祖父之事）
F. n. 祖父（指遗嘱里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 元老；前辈（the grandfather of the craft，指一件事里人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祖辈（抽象总称，指人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: thanked a grandfather that no cousin in the yard would have described
The grandfather, meaning the man himself and not the portrait
the grandfather at the far gate
the grandfather was the whole of the matter
the grandfather had become a line in a will
The grandfather of the whole thing
A grandfather, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: thank a grandfather 意为“向一位祖父道谢”，1960 年那个男孩向院子里没有一位表亲肯描述的一位祖父道了谢。
grandfather 意为“祖父、外祖父”，指那个人本人而不是画像，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
grandfather 意为“祖父、外祖父”，指院子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一根矮矮的手杖。
grandfather 意为“祖父”，指最远那道门口留给孩子们去探望的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grandfather 意为“元老、前辈”，指一件事里人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位前辈就是那件事的全部。
grandfather 意为“祖辈”，指人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位祖父，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grandfather 意为“祖父”，指遗嘱里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1965 年这一位成了遗嘱里的一行。
grandfather 意为“祖父”，男孩十一月写道，整件事的祖父之事是一处院子和三个秋天的描述。
grandfather 意为“祖父”，我记得的是遗嘱里描述过的那一位，1967 年过世了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一位。
grandfather 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，一位祖父是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
